to.section: Purpose: ordered goals with start, checkpoint, blocker, failure records under .omc/ultragoal
Use when: durable cross-session ledger, ordered stories, completion gated by slop cleanup and verification, /goal coordination
Do not use: single small change, invoking /goal from the shell, planning-only artifact
Why it exists: /goal is a session-scoped stop hook; ledger coordinates it
Plugin-only installs: replace the omc prefix with the plugin invocation
Create plan from brief or explicit stories; default aggregate mode; multi-repo and parallel sessions
Start or resume next story with complete-goals; set native goal; work the story
Checkpoint story with evidence; final story requires quality-gate JSON
If final review is not clean: record review blockers as a new story, keep goal active
Inspect state with omc ultragoal status
Limitations: shell cannot mutate /goal; snapshots are model-supplied proof; rename risk
Parallel caveats: multi-repo anchor, session id source, plan id conflicts, parallel verdict
